records.title: Future Scientists Scholarship (منحة علماء المستقبل) 2026/2027 — Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research and Central Bank of Egypt

validation.notes: Identity is proven on the awarding body's own government domain, mohesr.gov.eg = Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (Egypt), which the record names as official_source. Provenance and accessibility are solid; confidence is MEDIUM rather than HIGH for two reasons. (1) Scope: this is the Ministry's institutional mark, not a Future Scientists Scholarship programme mark - the scholarship's own application portal https://futurescholars.mohesr.gov.eg (the shard's catalogue_url) is unreachable from this environment (DNS resolves to 102.223.94.116 but TCP 443 and TCP 80 both time out, curl 'Failed to connect ... after ~21 s'), so no scholarship-specific mark could be evaluated. (2) not_ui is false because the asset is served as the site's header logo (class='logo-image'), which is how a site publishes its institutional mark; it is not browser/UI chrome, a sprite, or a favicon, so section 7 does not exclude it. It is 314 x 90 px PNG (25 838 bytes) - above favicon/badge scale, well within normal logo resolution. Rejected on the shard's official_source_url: sis.gov.eg is the State Information Services news agency, a third party to this award, and the only images there are /Assets/Images/logo.png (the SIS agency logo - wrong identity) plus og:image /media/819315/790003278-1088673930382360-7402522570707545076-n-1.jpg, an editorial news photograph, not a logo. Also rejected: /Assets/Images/favicon.ico and /Assets/images/icons/icon-152x152.png on the same page. No Central Bank of Egypt mark was used: cbe.org.eg is a co-sponsor rather than the awarding body, so its logo would misidentify the provider. Recommend a re-run of this record from a network that can reach 102.223.94.116 to look for a programme-specific Future Scientists mark.
